card.name: Words after around or round
card.fires_on: The word or space right after "around"/"round", especially "the", and words like "surroundings" or "surrounded by". It fires where a place or object is being circled or encircled.

modes.label: Round the dose

modes.label: Surround words
modes.description: Fires on "surroundings" or "by" in surrounded-by phrasing.
modes.example: is surrounded<< by>> a continuous vaulted arcade
